en.headline: Ho Man Tin and Mong Kok power restored after overnight outage
en.dek: CLP said equipment near Waterloo Road failed at 11.18pm on Wednesday, cutting supply to about 1,000 customers; full restoration came after a second morning interruption.
body: CLP Power said a fault on equipment near Waterloo Road in Kowloon City at about 11.18pm on Wednesday cut electricity to about 1,000 customers in Ho Man Tin and nearby Mong Kok, including residential blocks and the Metropark Hotel Kowloon.

The company said engineering crews and mobile generators restored supply to all affected customers at 3.47am on Thursday. Temporary supply then became unstable as morning demand rose, briefly affecting about 650 customers before power was restored again by about 8am.

Buildings named in local reports included Lung Cheung Building, Tsang Yung Building, Chi Ling Building and Freedom Building on Waterloo Road, and at least three blocks on Ho Man Tin Street. An elderly resident who relies on an oxygen machine was taken to hospital after the overnight interruption; CLP said it was coordinating with the district office, councillors and building managers.
CLP said it was still tracing the cause, with crews opening the road to inspect underground cables. Golden Week hotel guests interviewed by local outlets said they would keep their itineraries.

zh.headline: 何文田旺角停電後復電 中電指今早一度再受影響
zh.dek: 中電表示周三晚上11時18分窩打老道附近設備故障，約1,000名客戶受影響；清晨復電後今早臨時供電不穩，約650戶一度再停電。
body: 中電表示，9月30日晚上約11時18分，九龍城區窩打老道附近供電設備故障，何文田及附近旺角約1,000名客戶停電，受影響範圍包括多幢住宅及香港九龍維景酒店。
中電指工程人員全力搶修並調動流動發電機，於今日上午3時47分為所有受影響客戶恢復供電。今早居民陸續用電，臨時供電因負載不穩，約650名客戶一度再受影響，經搶修後於上午8時左右陸續復電。
本地報道指窩打老道龍翔大廈、曾榕大廈、芝齡大廈、自由大廈及何文田街最少三幢大廈受影響。一名長期依靠呼吸機的長者因停電被送院檢查。中電表示正與民政事務處、區議員及物業管理公司協調，並為院舍及樓宇提供流動電池及緊急照明。
中電仍在追查原因，今早有工人開路檢查地底電纜。黃金周入住受影響酒店的旅客向本地傳媒表示，會按原定行程繼續行程。
